Google Sans.name: Google Sans
Google Sans.role: Headlines, section link headers, category navigation tabs (500 weight), date headers, and weather display.

Product Sans.name: Product Sans
Product Sans.role: Brand lockup suffix wordmark ('News' in Google News header logo lockup, 22px 400 weight). The 'Google' portion is the official vector SVG brandmark.

Google Sans Text.name: Google Sans Text
Google Sans Text.role: Article body copy, publisher / source names, publication timestamps, pill coverage buttons, search input field, and interactive controls.

Roboto.name: Roboto
Roboto.role: Fallback and secondary font for body copy, system controls, and density-optimized UI elements.
